Your instructor

Profile

Kian Keong OoiEmbedded-systems engineer · Lecturer · Mentor

I teach learners to connect theory, code, and what the hardware actually does.

I am an electronics engineering professional with 30 years of experience across embedded systems, analogue and digital electronics, control systems, sensors, signal processing, and product development.

Today, I teach electronic and computer engineering, electrical and electronic engineering, robotics, and coding. My aim is to make difficult ideas approachable without removing the engineering discipline behind them.

Teaching approach

Explain the “why”

Every circuit and code pattern is connected to the physical behaviour it creates.

Learn by evidence

Measurements, serial output, controlled tests, and design reviews turn faults into learning.

Build progressively

Start with one reliable function, then add capability without losing clarity.

Think beyond the demo

Consider robustness, memory, timing, interfaces, maintainability, and user needs.
